regions.region: page 1 title, authors, metadata, abstract, and Supporting Information notice
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and the current visible-light enantioselective organocatalytic allene-radical cascade class. The online Supporting Information notice does not establish a workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and prior SET/allene discussion
regions.finding: Separated cited metal/cycloaddition/radical chemistry and prior electrochemical/UV SET oxidation from the present reaction design. Prior literature was not promoted to a current-paper experiment.

unresolved: Page 1 has no concrete reaction row, experimental charge, or product-specific outcome.

regions.finding: Classified Scheme 1a as cited/prior allene-cation-radical pathways and Scheme 1b as the authors' current generic cascade design. Generic R groups do not define one experiment.

Recorded one proposed catalytic mechanism: iminium formation/excitation, SET oxidation, polar-radical crossover, radical coupling, aldol cyclization, and acyl migration. C-G are proposed, not isolated preparations.

regions.region: page 2 lower two-column mechanistic rationale and start of optimization
regions.finding: Linked the stated excited-iminium and substrate redox-potential ranges to the mechanism record and the model 1a/2a/amine-3 reaction to Table 1 on page 3; no prose duplicate was created.

unresolved: SI-only illumination and electrochemical details were not imported.
Proposed intermediates have no direct observation or isolation status in the covered pages.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 1 reaction drawing, catalyst structures, entries 1-10, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all ten optimization/control rows independently with row catalyst/additive/solvent, shared 0.1 mmol scale, 0.40 mL/0.25 M, 35 °C/18 h, 420 nm/90 mW cm-2 light, isolated yields, ee values or source dashes, and explicit no-light/no-acid/no-amine controls. Entry 2 is merged with Scheme 3 product 4a and the page-5 procedure.
Mapped the TFA, Zn/Sc triflate, solvent, catalyst-3b, and control statements to Table 1 rows. Preserved the entry-2 prose/table yield conflict: prose 55% versus table/procedure 56%.

regions.region: page 3 right Scheme 3 products 4a-j and caption
regions.finding: Recorded all ten scope products as distinct experiments, merging 4a with identical Table 1 entry 2. Product-specific isolated yields/ee and >19:1 crude-NMR dr are retained; shared 0.1 mmol/3 equiv enal/20 mol% 3a/Zn(OTf)2/light conditions are applied row-wise.

unresolved: Scheme 3 gives a shared 18-72 h range, not exact product-specific times except 4a's 18 h procedure.
Complex scope structures remain source-labeled with null SMILES where safe complete encoding was uncertain.
Zero-yield control rows have no numerical detection limit or alternative-product identity.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left scope narrative and aliphatic-enal limitation
regions.finding: Linked 4a-j trends to existing Scheme 3 rows. The prose states that aliphatic enals completely inhibit reactivity, but no concrete substrate label, charge, or row outcome is printed, so no unsupported failure record was fabricated.

regions.region: page 4 upper/right Scheme 4 reaction header, products 6a-j/7a-j, X-ray panel, caption, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Recorded ten ordered two-stage experiments. Each first stage has isolated 6 yield/ee; each second stage has 7 yield/dr. Footnotes apply 5 equiv BF3.OEt2 only to 7e, EtCN only to the 6f first stage, and TFA 60 mol%/CH3CN 0.5 M only to 6g-j first stages. CCDC 1944502 identifies 7f characterization.
Linked the Zn-coordinated aldol/acyl-migration interpretation and TS1 barrier to the Figure 1 mechanism/computation record; no computed intermediate was treated as an experiment.

unresolved: The aliphatic-enal limitation lacks a concrete row/substrate identity and numerical detection limit.
Scheme 4 does not print second-stage temperature/time or product-7 ee values.
Scope structures remain source-labeled and unverified where stereochemical encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Figure 1 and concluding DFT discussion
regions.finding: Recorded the computed H0-TS1-H1-TS2-H2 free-energy profile (+10.5, +7.6, +11.0, -9.7 kcal/mol) and 1,3-diaxial stereochemical interpretation as a mechanism/computation record, not synthetic preparations.

Merged exact charges (1 0.1 mmol; 3a 14.1 mg/0.02 mmol/0.20 equiv; enal 0.30 mmol/3 equiv; Zn(OTf)2 9.1 mg/0.025 mmol/0.25 equiv; CH3CN 400 uL), three freeze-pump-thaw cycles/argon, 420 nm/90±2 mW cm-2, 18-72 h, 1 g silica adsorption, reduced-pressure solvent removal, and flash chromatography into Scheme 3 records.
